recent.text: Pistons break it open in fourth quarter, expanding six-point lead with big surge, en route to 122-109 road victory over #Pelicans in New Orleans. Zion Williamson 24 pts; Jordan Poole 22 pts. Postgame wrap: https://t.co/eFAay59q8c https://t.co/JFPTNBCtRi
recent.author: Jim Eichenhofer

recent.text: Pelicans lose 122-109 to Pistons. Was six-point deficit after three quarters, but Detroit began fourth on 19-8 run, killing hopes for Nola comeback. Pelicans lacked cohesion of Pistons, and defensively, were too often discombobulated. Zion Williamson: 24 PTS Jordan Poole: 22 PTS
recent.author: Oleh Kosel 🇺🇦🇺🇸🇦🇺

recent.text: Jeremiah Fears fouls out for the first time in his NBA career. He finishes with a line of 16 points, five rebounds and four assists.

recent.text: DeAndre Jordan has made four of his five free throw attempts for the game, and is now 10 of 13 from the free throw line on the season. A career 47.6% free throw shooter is 76.9% from the line in his 19th season. Pretty remarkable stuff.
